"""Freeze fixed V162 reductions and viewing sources before endpoint quality."""
import ast
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V162-flat-target-anchor-v1'
snapshot=root/'protocol-document-v1.md';assert not snapshot.exists();snapshot.write_bytes((repo/'docs/flat-target-anchor.md').read_bytes())
mapping={'summarize-v161-final-v1.py':'summarize-v162-final-v1.py','build-v161-tables-v1.py':'build-v162-tables-v1.py',
    'paired-v161-regions-v1.py':'paired-v162-regions-v1.py','quiet-dc-v161-final-v1.py':'quiet-dc-v162-final-v1.py',
    'record-v161-viewing-v1.py':'record-v162-viewing-v1.py','route-v161-final-v1.py':'route-v162-final-v1.py',
    'compare-v161-retained-v1.py':'compare-v162-retained-v1.py'}
sources=[]
for old,new in mapping.items():
 p=repo/'.cache'/new;assert not p.exists();s=(repo/'.cache'/old).read_text()
 s=s.replace('V161-harmonic-context-v1','V162-flat-target-anchor-v1').replace('v161-harmonic-context','v162-flat-target-anchor')
 s=s.replace('paired-control','harmonic-control').replace('harmonic-context','flat-anchor')
 for a,b in [('Pair ctrl raw','Harm ctrl raw'),('Pair ctrl EMA','Harm ctrl EMA'),('Harmonic raw','Flat anchor raw'),('Harmonic EMA','Flat anchor EMA')]:s=s.replace(a,b)
 if old.startswith('paired'):
  a=s.index("    'scope':");b=s.index('\n',a)
  s=s[:a]+"    'scope':'Lower-is-better actual errors preserve every case/worst increase. All4 current endpoints versus parent and2 candidate/control contrasts. Identical124397-parameter harmonic heads/data/base losses;only flat-target anchor weight0 versus.25 changes. Exact V161 controls. Related adaptive cohort,not independent scenes/significance.'})"+s[b:]
 if old.startswith('record'):
  a=s.index("        'scope':");b=s.index('\n',a)
  s=s[:a]+"        'scope':'All four fixed V162 endpoints;only target-flat anchor weight0 versus.25 changes. Six retained V156/V157/V158/V159/V160 ordinary/V160 paired columns. Original-detail viewing recorded only after seeing images. Both protected GFX scenes/windows/priors/JPEGs assessed;ISO100 refs qualitative,not exactGT.'})"+s[b:]
 if old.startswith('compare'):
  needle="    'V160 ordinary':(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V160-paired-response-v1','ordinary'),";assert needle in s
  s=s.replace(needle,needle+"\n    'V160 paired':(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V160-paired-response-v1','paired-response'),\n    'V161':(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V161-harmonic-context-v1','harmonic-context'),")
  a=s.index("    'scope':");b=s.index('\n',a)
  s=s[:a]+"    'scope':'All four current endpoints compared with both endpoints of V156/V157/V158/V159/V160 ordinary/V160 paired/V161. Historical contrasts mix data/loss/architecture;only current harmonic-control versus flat-anchor isolates anchor weight0/.25. Related cohort,not independent scenes/significance. Lower errors preserve cases/worst increases;response means stay separate.'})"+s[b:]
 ast.parse(s);p.write_text(s);sources.append(ref(p))
save(root/'final-helper-preparation-v1.json',{'status':'fixed-reductions-prepared-before-quality','sources':sources,
    'protocol_snapshot':ref(snapshot),'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0})
print('Prepared7 fixed reduction/table/viewing sources;not executed')
